description: A wide 16:9 sequence diagram of one function-calling round trip, read left to right, with three tall vertical lanes as rounded columns. Left lane header: 'Our code (Ask Rasoi)'. Middle lane header: 'LLM (gemini-3.8-flash)'. Right lane header: 'Bahi ERP'. Six numbered horizontal arrows going down the page in order: arrow 1 from 'Our code' to 'LLM' labelled '1  messages + tool definitions (JSON)'. Arrow 2 from 'LLM' back to 'Our code' labelled '2  tool_call: check_stock {item_code: GSK-SIL-05L}'. Arrow 3 from 'Our code' to 'Bahi ERP' labelled '3  our code runs the tool in Kavita's session'. Arrow 4 from 'Bahi ERP' back to 'Our code' labelled '4  result: 54,000 on hand in Pune'. Arrow 5 from 'Our code' to 'LLM' labelled '5  tool result message'. Arrow 6 from 'LLM' to 'Our code' labelled '6  answer in words'. A thin dashed vertical barrier between the LLM lane and the Bahi lane with the small label 'the model never touches Bahi'. Arrows 1, 2, 5, 6 in sky blue, arrows 3 and 4 in ember orange. The three lane headers are exactly 'Our code (Ask Rasoi)', 'LLM (gemini-3.8-flash)' and 'Bahi ERP', and nothing above them. Do not add any column headers, row headers, section titles or labels other than the ones quoted here. Labels as plain text, no brackets.

A wide 16:9 figure with two horizontal rows comparing whose permissions an MCP server carries. TOP row, sky blue: a box 'Ask Rasoi, Kavita signed in', an arrow to a box 'MCP server started as KJOSHI', an arrow to a box 'Bahi: Kavita's role and her Rs 2,50,000 limit', and at the end a result tag 'approve PO/2026/01179: ACCESS DENIED (ERR-SEC-0001)'. BOTTOM row, ember orange: a box 'Ask Rasoi, anyone', an arrow to a box 'MCP server started as SVC_AGENT', an arrow to a box 'Bahi: service account, no limit', and at the end a result tag 'approve PO/2026/01179: APPROVED by SVC_AGENT'. A short caption between the rows on the left: 'same tool, same call'.  Do not add any column headers, row headers, section titles or labels other than the ones quoted here. Labels as plain text, no brackets.

A wide 16:9 comparison figure with two horizontal bands. TOP band, light ember-orange tint, caption at its top left: 'Raw services: 41 tools'. Inside it a neat grid of exactly 41 small rounded chips, 11 per row in 4 rows (the last row has 8), each chip showing exactly one of these names, in this order: 'itm_search', 'itm_get', 'sup_search', 'sup_get', 'sup_create', 'sup_cert_get', 'sup_cert_upload', 'sup_rate_get', 'cc_list', 'cc_get', 'whs_list', 'tax_list', 'pt_list', 'usr_get', 'usr_roles', 'stk_query', 'stk_ledger', 'stk_reorder_list', 'pr_fetch', 'pr_save', 'pr_submit', 'pr_approve', 'pr_get', 'pr_search', 'po_fetch', 'po_save', 'po_get', 'po_search', 'po_hist', 'po_pending_appr', 'po_approve', 'po_reject', 'po_release', 'po_amend', 'po_cancel', 'tax_compute', 'bud_check', 'ntf_send', 'grn_save', 'grn_get', 'grn_search'. Every chip uses one of those 41 names exactly; do not invent or shorten any name. A note at the top right of the band: 'the model must know the order'. BOTTOM band, light sky-blue tint, caption at its top left: 'Toolbox: 15 tools, one per business activity'. Inside it 15 rounded chips in 3 rows of 5, slightly larger, horizontal text, names in this order: 'find_item', 'check_stock', 'find_supplier', 'check_budget', 'search_policy', 'create_purchase_request', 'list_my_approvals', 'approve_purchase_request', 'create_purchase_order', 'approve_purchase_order', 'release_purchase_order', 'order_status', 'receive_goods', 'register_supplier', 'send_message'. A note at the top right of the bottom band: 'the tool knows the order'. No connecting lines between the bands.
